name: contour-local-additive-flux-mechanism
status: Root-approved one-time additive numeric amendment after v2 full70 preflight failure; require first3 bit/native parity before one full70 retry, no fitting/public use
amendment_reason: The v2 full70 stopped on source shot index42 frame337 because 19/512 matched contour points exceeded a 4-grid-diagonal cap borrowed from the old invertible TPS warp. This new additive map has no inverse coordinate warp to fold. On the offending frame the unchanged lambda1/width formula is finite float32 and edge-bit exact, max |delta psi| is 0.009464 (2.48% of source range), LCFS extraction remains valid, and contour-to-true distance improves 0.242015 to 0.168083m. Remove ONLY the borrowed displacement cap; record max/p95 displacement and retain all other source/topology/TPS/finite/edge/scalar/native-failure checks. No lambda or width tuning.
question: Does a first-order, contour-local correction preserve the shape/LCFS mechanism seen in the three-shot inverse-warp smoke while avoiding its interior-li and inverse-conditioning costs?
scope: Truth-assisted mechanism probe on labeled DIII-D training-corpus tail only. True psi may supply C_true for this diagnostic, never a deployable model or public prediction. This is a new additive map construction, not an eighth inverse-warp safety amendment.

input.source_dtype: float32 for psirz, q95 and betaN
input.truth_usage: Only scorer-native C_true extracted from efit_psirz of labeled, fit-excluded train-corpus shots. No true interior psi pixels, stored scalar labels or public targets are inserted in any output.

smoke.selection_rule: The same first three files of the pinned salt-0 70-shot score order, chosen before the additive correction is scored
smoke.purpose: Correctness and mechanism gate only; pooled three-shot S is not a generalization estimate
smoke.next_step: Root reviews smoke validity, contour/shape movement, li tradeoff, timing and all native fields before any full-70 run. No full-70 run, model fit or public use is authorized by this spec alone.

construction.contours: Extract C_pred and C_true as the frozen scorer's 512-point closed physical (R,Z) LCFS. Reject missing/non-simple contours; reverse orientation if needed, then choose the single cyclic arclength shift minimizing summed squared physical displacement with lowest-shift ties. No star-shaped or radial assumption.
construction.displacement_controls: Reuse the fixed prior A forward-displacement geometry: 64 uniformly spaced C_pred-to-C_true boundary controls, predicted magnetic-axis zero-displacement anchor, and 16 zero-displacement grid-edge anchors (four corners plus 1/4, 1/2 and 3/4 of every edge). Fit the same 2-D thin-plate-spline RBF in unit-normalized grid coordinates with smoothing=0.0001 and degree=1. Transform its displacement back to physical metres before applying the flux update.
construction.boundary_taper: For every point x=(R,Z), m=0.5 times the minimum physical distance of any C_pred point to any grid edge. h(t)=0 at t<=0, 3t^2-2t^3 at 0<t<1, 1 at t>=1. T(x) is the product h((R-Rmin)/m)h((Rmax-R)/m)h((Z-Zmin)/m)h((Zmax-Z)/m). Require T=0 at every grid-edge pixel and T=1 at every contour control and the predicted axis. Set u_phys(x)=T(x)*(span_R*u_RBF_R(x),span_Z*u_RBF_Z(x)).
construction.shell: Let d(x,C_pred) be the nearest Euclidean physical distance from each grid point to one of the 512 scorer-resampled predicted contour points, measured by cKDTree. Set width=2*min(diff(grid_R),diff(grid_Z)) metres from that shot's physical grid, fixed without tuning. Set w(x)=exp(-0.5*(d/width)^2). The discrete-point distance approximation is part of the frozen construction, not an optimized exact-polyline distance.
construction.gradient: Compute dpsi_dZ,dpsi_dR=np.gradient(psi_old.astype(float64),grid_Z,grid_R) on the original 65x65 physical grid, matching the scorer's grid orientation. Require finite values.
construction.map_update: With fixed lambda=1, psi_new(x)=psi_old(x)-w(x)*(u_phys_R(x)*dpsi_dR(x)+u_phys_Z(x)*dpsi_dZ(x)); compute in float64 and cast once to finite float32. This is the first-order Taylor approximation to psi_old(x-u), without solving an inverse map. There is no weight or width sweep, clipping, flux sign flip, or replacement with true psi pixels.
construction.submitted_scalars: Copy q95 and betaN arrays byte-identically from the original float32 NPZ for every shot; do not change their weights or values.
construction.outputs: Actual finite float32 psi maps, never overridden LCFS or derived scalar reports. Store max and p95 matched contour displacement, max |delta psi|, max |u_phys|, shell width and boundary psi bit identity. Record scorer-native source/corrected contour distances where extraction succeeds and corrected-map LCFS/consistency failure counts through the native scorer. Never copy a true psi pixel into the result.

validity.preflight: Verify frozen source NPZ hash, exact ordered filenames/frames, scorer source hashes, original map/scalar shape/dtype/finiteness, true and predicted contour topology and positive contour-to-grid-edge margin. All errors carry shot basename and frame index; fail fast without skipping or mean repair.
validity.control_correspondence: Require unique TPS anchors, finite TPS values and full contour/axis taper strength. Record max/p95 matched physical displacement but do not reject on a displacement cap inherited from the unrelated inverse-warp fold gate. The fixed additive finite-map and native LCFS checks remain authoritative.
validity.post_map: Fail fast only if psi_new has wrong (T,65,65) shape/dtype, nonfinite entries or grid-edge psi bits differ from psi_old. Construct a source-control NPZ whose every array is bit-identical to the pinned input. Do not require coordinate-warp Jacobian/inverse gates because no coordinate inverse is computed. If the finite corrected map has no LCFS or a derived scalar fails, keep the map and let the unchanged native scorer apply its normal penalties; record failure counts, never substitute true geometry.
validity.failure_interpretation: A numeric validity failure is a failure of this one additive family, not evidence that all boundary corrections fail. A valid small-shot S difference is mechanism evidence only, not an expected public or full-70 gain.

scoring.native_comparison: Build source control and additive candidate NPZs for the same ordered files; score both through untouched frozen local_score.main. Report S, R2psi, R2qb, raw D_LCFS, Consistency and all seven per-derived-scalar R2, failures and shot/frame counts. Never implement a second metric.
scoring.comparison_anchor: The first-three-shot original source control was already natively scored at S 0.944391; recompute or verify its file/metrics hashes before comparison. Prior A v6 three-shot S 0.965705 is context only and cannot substitute for the additive candidate's own native score.

expected_cost_and_gate.implementation_gate: No code or score before root reviews this exact math/spec. Then run only three-shot correctness smoke; full-70 requires separate root review.
expected_cost_and_gate.mechanism_readout: Count frames with improved/worsened scorer-native contour distance. Compare kappa/volume/LCFS and li changes against the same three-shot source control, but do not select lambda or width using those outcomes.
